data.name: Pill It Up!
data.detailed_description:
Pill It Up!

Trust is your greatest weapon... and your greatest weakness.

Pill It Up! is a 4–12 player online social deduction game where communication, deception, and deduction determine who survives. Every round, each player must identify the only pill that will keep them alive—but no one has enough information to solve the mystery alone.

Talk with other players, compare clues, question every statement, and decide who you can trust. Some players may be telling the truth, some may be mistaken, and others may be deliberately manipulating everyone. Every decision matters, because choosing the wrong pill means death.

Work Together... or Deceive Everyone

Every player receives different clues about other players' pills. Share information, uncover contradictions, and piece everything together before time runs out. Success depends on communication, observation, and your ability to separate facts from lies.

Sometimes trusting the wrong person is all it takes to lose.

Built-in Voice & Video Communication

Watch reactions, read body language, and pay attention to every hesitation. Pill It Up! is designed around player interaction, allowing every conversation to become part of the game. A confident smile might hide a lie, while silence could reveal the truth.

Multiple Unique Game Modes

Experience a variety of game modes that constantly change how you play. Some modes focus on sharing information, others introduce false clues, restrict communication, or force players to solve the mystery in completely different ways. Special Open Area events also appear throughout matches, bringing everyone together for unique challenges that can dramatically change the outcome.

Customize Your Matches

Create the perfect lobby for your group with fully customizable settings.

  • Enable or disable game modes

  • Choose the number of rounds

  • Adjust round timers

  • Create public or private lobbies

  • Protect rooms with passwords

  • Hide rooms from the lobby browser

  • Join games instantly with room codes

Play exactly the way your group wants.

Steam Multiplayer

Powered by Steam Networking, Pill It Up! lets you easily host games, invite friends, browse public lobbies, or join private rooms using room codes. Jump into matches in seconds and enjoy a smooth online multiplayer experience.

Every Match Is Different

Randomized clues, changing player positions, rotating game modes, and unpredictable player interactions ensure that no two matches are ever the same. Every game becomes a new social experiment where trust is constantly tested.

Key Features

  • Online multiplayer for 4–12 players

  • Social deduction gameplay

  • Built-in voice and video communication

  • Multiple unique game modes

  • Randomized clues every round

  • Steam Networking

  • Public and private lobbies

  • Hidden rooms and room code support

  • Password-protected lobbies

  • Fully customizable match settings

  • Multilingual interface

  • High replayability

Trust carefully.

Question everyone.

Choose the right pill.

Survive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound card
